title: Learning through Communication: Training LLM Agents via Communication with Linguistic and Non-Linguistic Feedback

defines.name: Learning through Communication (LTC)
defines.definition: A universal framework for training LLM agents using both linguistic feedback and non-linguistic reward signals through iterative exploration and policy updating.

problem: Existing methods for training LLM agents can only partially use heterogeneous feedback, failing to jointly exploit linguistic trajectories and non-linguistic reward signals.
